headline: Inference-time control of pretrained sequence models replaces retraining for design tasks
label: Steering Pretrained Biomolecular Generators
summary: Codon, peptide, RNA and small-molecule design now steer frozen generators via activations, RL, verifier search and gradients rather than retraining.
synthesis: The dominant thread is control applied on top of pretrained generative models rather than new base architectures. ARCADE steers genomic language models by activation engineering to hit continuous codon targets (CAI, minimum free energy, GC content). PredMem adds a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries soft logit beliefs across masked co-generation of protein sequence and structure. KnitNet learns from verifier feedback at inference time for exact RNA inverse folding. Reinforcement learning appears repeatedly: CPPainter guides a masked-LM peptide generator, DPO and DiffusionNFT steer pocket-conditioned molecular generation toward make-on-demand libraries, and PPO, QR-DQN and Rainbow DQN are compared for CRISPR spacer refinement. GRACE instead uses predictor gradients with null-space projection and an augmented Lagrangian for constrained sequence redesign. Counterweights exist: MSA content is treated as a tunable input, MSA Transformer features yield mixed enzyme-recommendation gains, and a kinetic-parameter benchmark adds mechanistic evaluation.
